pages.text: $(l)Dread$(), from the Mourners: you cannot run, and walk heavily.$(br2)$(l)Delirium$(), from the Wraiths: you hear rats, steps, doors and bells that are not there.$(br2)$(l)Rotting$(), from the flies: the raw meat you carry spoils, a piece at a time.$(br2)None of them can hurt you on their own.
